name: udbud_dk-mcp
description: Udbud (deals): me, search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_udbud_dk_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_UDBUD_DK_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_udbud_dk_client_id.description: client_id issued by Udbud.dk / Erhvervsstyrelsen after registering your system (registration form linked from the SDK README) with the MU_API_DATASYNK role.

platform_mcp_udbud_dk_private_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_UDBUD_DK_PRIVATE_KEY
platform_mcp_udbud_dk_private_key.description: PEM RSA private key whose public key you expose in the JWKS endpoint registered with Udbud.dk (private_key_jwt client assertion, RS256).

platform_mcp_udbud_dk_key_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_UDBUD_DK_KEY_ID
platform_mcp_udbud_dk_key_id.description: kid of that key in your JWKS.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Mints a token with the private_key_jwt client assertion and reads one notice registered since yesterday: verifies the MU_API_DATASYNK role.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET /ekstern-data/bekendtgoerelse/v1/fraKilde/DKUDBUD?since=<30 days ago>&page&size: the data-sync feed of Danish notices (DKUDBUD source) registered in the last 30 days, oldest first. Each record is noticeId, noticeVersion, publication number, registration time and the full eForms notice as base64-encoded UTF-8 XML (xml_base64 — decode it for title, buyer and deadlines). There is no keyword search: `query`/`category`/`min_budget` are not applied. For get_posting pass id as <noticeId>/<noticeVersion>.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /ekstern-data/bekendtgoerelse/v1/{noticeId}/{noticeVersion}: pass id as '<noticeId>/<noticeVersion>' (e.g. 6a26cc22-a211-41ea-867f-c34b4d726154/01). The notice is returned as base64-encoded eForms XML (xml_base64).
